retrieved_chunks.text: CLASS ACTIVITY • "If a computer has 5 billion transistors today,how many could it have after 10 years if the transistor count doubles every 2 years?“ Moore’s Law • Moore’s Law is the prediction that the number of transistors on a chip will double roughly every two years, with a minimal increase in cost. • Moore’s Law, created by Gordon Moore before he co-founded Intel, has remained the golden rule for the electronics industry since its 1965 publication. • Moore’s Law only stops when innovation stops, and innovation continues to push forward.
